scope: Synthetic connected design preview; real browser IndexedDB transactions/process restart; simulated source/sign-in/lease/denial/write receipt
browserPath: Browser plugin and browser skill not listed; regular Playwright used for local synthetic preview

checks.name: Shared-device online demonstration retains no player/session rows
First page and resumable cursor commit together; partial is not complete
Reload stays locked, then resumes original snapshot without repeating first page
Browser process restart reopens real persisted rows; unchanged check transfers zero dataset pages
Covered navigation, indexed late-page name search, day selection and inspector cause zero fixture exchanges
Aborted change transaction preserves rows plus revision and unsaved input
checks.failure: Injected real IDB transaction abort, not a physical quota fault

checks.name: Sparse changes move/update/remove exactly four records, advance checked revisions and retain focus/selection/input
Failed version check retains last-checked data and dirty input
Dirty navigation has native dialog, Escape preserves task and explicit leave discards
Already-open disconnected tab reads covered local records without a fetch; commands/checks unavailable
Missing period differs from checked-empty; empty completion prevents repeated snapshot download
Separate Academy B namespace remains complete-empty and never renders A records
Original synthetic save identity survives refresh and replica removal; reconciliation uses the same ID
Two-tab preparation uses Web Locks and committed-data invalidation
checks.limitation: Does not establish product cross-tab authority or leader-crash correctness

checks.name: Simulated expiry/clock uncertainty locks private views pending simulated online verification
Known simulated denial survives reopening and cannot be unlocked by a late local result
Expired partial snapshot discards staged directory only, preserves completed month, then rebases bounded pages
Locale change preserves typed search; Arabic name-prefix index returns covered rows
Quiet snapshot commit preserves focused Calendar result control
Review reset accurately declares and removes all fictional scopes and synthetic operation references
Removed focused result falls back to current task instead of lost body focus
EN/AR dark/light layout matrix has no document overflow
Settled dark/light body and representative action contrast exceeds 4.5:1
Phone navigation contains/restores keyboard focus and optional details close with Escape to the opener
Unavailable IndexedDB fails closed; no volatile result is labelled durable
Page identity, meaningful content, no framework overlay/runtime errors, no external or operating-service requests

profile.source: all fixture exchanges in same browser process; no artificial network comparison
profile.dataset: 128 players;64 November sessions;24 each adjacent month;empty February
profile.latency: 500ms per synthetic snapshot page;450ms per synthetic change page, expressly not network performance

limits: No production, real account/data or access change
Unlock and lease are simulations; rows unencrypted fictional data
No physical quota/eviction, Safari/iOS/Android or assistive technology proof
No offline cold app shell or closed-tab background guarantee
No product offline write queue/security approval
40-date program and18-player register remain existing reference cases, not implemented by this preview
